sections.heading: Flagged items in detail
paragraphs: Inventory vs. Sales / COGS Trend: Inventory intensity changed +10.5 percentage points of total assets and inventory days moved -54 days. Stock is building faster than sales, a classic early warning of demand weakness or channel stuffing.
CapEx Intensity Check: Capital expenditure averaged 13.4% of revenue. Capex intensity is unusual for the business model and needs a return check.
Earnings Volatility Check: Earnings per share fell in 0 of the last 4 years with a growth standard deviation of 366 points. Earnings are erratic, which argues for a wider margin of safety.

Auditor & Governance Cleanliness: Aggregating the accounting evidence: 2 hard red flags and 1 watch items, with a LojikX™ Consistency Score of 61/100. The pattern of flags warrants a closer read of the auditor notes and related-party disclosures.
